candidates.spoken: Qantas Flight 32 suffered an uncontained engine failure.
The engine didn't fail from bird strike or fuel.
A fatigue crack leaked oil, which caught fire.
In seconds, debris tore through the wing and cut wiring.
Minutes after leaving Singapore, an A380's engine exploded.
The crew spent nearly two hours working through failures.
Engines with the faulty pipe were inspected and replaced.
A turbine disc overheated and burst.
misaligned counterbore thinning an oil feed stub pipe.
The cause was a small oil pipe inside the engine.
It had been machined off-centre, leaving its wall too thin.
It started with pipe bored off-centre. It ended with turbine disc bursts.
Nobody died, but debris cut wiring and a fuel tank.

script.spoken: Qantas Flight 32 suffered an uncontained engine failure. In seconds, debris tore through the wing and cut wiring. The crew spent nearly two hours working through failures, then landed safely. The cause was a small oil pipe inside the engine. It had been machined off-centre, leaving its wall too thin. A fatigue crack leaked oil, which caught fire. A turbine disc overheated and burst. Engines with the faulty pipe were inspected and replaced.
